items.question: A pre-registered study has 87 events in its key arm against a floor of 100, on a closed span (2025-01 to 2026-07). Session 2?

options.label: (a)
options.text: run now; every label NOT READABLE

options.label: (b)
options.text: re-register a signal-side variant as primary (113 events) before any outcome

options.label: (c)
options.text: backfill earlier years from the history host (2023-2024 first; flags verified in samples), re-register, then run

items.rationale: Keeps the measure and adds data. (a) unseals the span so no later design is outcome-blind; (b) chooses the primary after seeing counts; (d) discards a nearly readable study. Flags verified present in 2023 and 2024 samples; 2020-2022 coverage checked per year before extending.

items.question: Reference-grid step for the control population in a study whose power is bound by the 87-event arm
items.rationale: (b) records three times the reference windows; its only cost is script runtime in session 2.

items.question: Outcome measure for liquidation-fade trades

options.label: (d)
options.text: engine replay for structural-first placed levels, then (c)

items.rationale: (d) is what the engine would actually place. The replay loader already reads 11-column history-store files (fixture A94f). Session 2 checks the full replay can run; if not, fall back to (c) and say so.
